thread:
ana: Heads up — got an SBOM alert from the registry scan for staging image redwood/base:2026-03. It flagged an unsigned layer and a key mismatch when verifying cosign. Anyone on keystore rotation?

james: @ana which registry? staging or prod?

ana: staging. cosign verify returns: "ERROR: signature verification failed: public key mismatch". I can paste the output.

ana: ```
$ cosign verify --key k8s://secrets/keystore/signing-key staging.redwood.io/redwood/base:2026-03
Verification for staging.redwood.io/redwood/base:2026-03 -- FAILED
ERROR: signature verification failed: public key mismatch
```

maria: hmm, possible signer change during the bake window. @security-eng any recent signer key rotations? :eyes: 

security-eng: We rotated the prod keystore on 2026-02-28, but staging uses the test signer. Let me check audit logs — might be a propagation/duplicate-key situation.

keystore-bot: Audit log entry: 2026-03-09T14:52Z key-signing invoked by svc:artifact-baker; key_id=kb-7a24; context=staging-bake; request_id=aa1b2c3d

james: That key_id doesn't match the public key currently in the k8s secret. Could be a rollback or partial rekey.

ana: How do we recover? CI is blocked on image verify gate and we have a release cut coming.

security-eng: Two reasonable options: (A) re-sign the affected images with the current signing key, or (B) update the cosign-allowed secret to include the previous public key as a short-lived fallback. Re-signing is cleaner but requires rebuilds; fallback is faster but increases blast radius.

maria: Can we quantify how many images are impacted?

ana: Quick grep shows 8 base-image tags signed between 2026-03-05 and 2026-03-09 in staging. I can enumerate and push a re-sign job.

ana: tags: redwood/base:2026-03-05, redwood/base:2026-03-06, redwood/base:2026-03-06-rc1, redwood/base:2026-03-07, redwood/base:2026-03-08, redwood/base:2026-03-08-rc2, redwood/base:2026-03-09, redwood/base:2026-03-09-hotfix

james: Is there a keystore policy that lets us allow a previous key id for N hours? If so we can add an allowlist entry with TTL and then remove it after.

security-eng: We can. I'll open a minimal PR to patch allowlist + TTL and record the audit. Which do we want to do immediately? Meeting in 10m to decide? :clock10: 

maria: free in 10.

ana: CI needs unblocking now. Can someone manually bypass the gate for this run?

security-eng: We don't bypass gating. We either re-sign or add temporary fallback with clear audit. I'll start the PR.

keystore-bot: PR created by security-eng: repo=keystore, branch=hotfix/allowlist-kb-7a24, pr=#412, title=allow previous signer kb-7a24 for 72h

james: Also double-check the SBOM changes for unexpected layers — if there are extra layers that's a much higher priority.

ana: SBOM diff shows only signature metadata changes; no new layers or added packages. Looks like provenance only.

maria: Ok plan: (1) security-eng apply a 72h allowlist entry for kb-7a24, (2) ana/ci trigger re-signs for the 8 tags, (3) james run a provenance/audit check to confirm no malicious changes, (4) remove allowlist after TTL and merge revert PR.

security-eng: Posting playbook in thread.

security-eng: ```
Playbook (short window):
1) Patch k8s secret 'cosign-allowed' to include old-pub-kb-7a24 with metadata ttl=72h and reason="staging-signature-fallback"
2) Trigger re-sign job: svc:artifact-baker run 'cosign sign --key k8s://secrets/keystore/current' for each affected tag
3) Validate with 'cosign verify' across a subset of CI runners and staging nodes
4) Record audit entries for each action (PR refs, request_ids, bake job ids)
5) After 72h, remove the allowlist entry and close the hotfix PR
```

ana: I'll start re-signs now and post status.

ana: re-sign done for 4/8 tags (2026-03-05, 03-06, 03-06-rc1, 03-07). Remaining 4 queued for baker.

keystore-bot: Audit: re-sign actions recorded: request_ids=[bb22, cc33, dd44, ee55] for svc:artifact-baker

james: Verified cosign verify OK on three staging runners for the re-signed images.

maria: LGTM on checks. Please open a follow-up to prevent recurrence: ensure SBOM includes signer key_id and bake pipeline surfaces signer id in metadata.

security-eng: Follow-up filed: https://git.redwood/infra/issues/987 "track signer key_id in SBOM and bake metadata". Also adding a CI gate enhancement to surface key_id mismatch errors with clearer remediation steps.

ana: Thanks all. Once allowlist TTL expires, security-eng please remove the entry and post confirmation.

keystore-bot: Allowlist TTL set to 72h; will auto-expire at 2026-03-12T14:52Z if not removed earlier.

security-eng: Will monitor and remove earlier if rollout completes. Closing this thread after final audit. :white_check_mark: 

ana: Appreciate the quick turn. :thumbsup:
